content.markdown: Shared binders for `BasicAnalysis.sec.structures` and everything downstream. Declares `F G : PFun` (domain-carrying real functions), `A B : Seq` (index-windowed real sequences), `x x₀ L : ℝ` (points and candidate limits), `epsilon delta : ℝ` constrained positive (tolerance and threshold binders), `n N : ℕ` (index binders), and `I : Set ℝ` (an ambient interval or region).
